title: IKEA Recalls KULLEN 3 Drawer Chest Due to Tip-Over/ Entrapment Hazards
hazard: IKEA is voluntarily recalling KULLEN 3 drawer chest in birch and black/brown. The chest is unstable if it is not anchored to the wall, posing tip over and entrapment hazards.
remedy: Customers that have a KULLEN 3 drawer chest, that is not properly anchored to the wall, are urged to stop using it and place it in an area that children cannot access. If you have a recalled chest, please contact IKEA for a choice between two options: a refund or a free wall-attachment kit. Customers can order a free wall-attachment repair kit for self-installation or IKEA will provide a one-time, free in-home installation service. IKEA will accept in-store returns or arrange for a free pick up of the chests for a refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. To participate in the recall, please click here .

hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the IKEA 365+ VÄRDEFULL garlic press, article 305.781.89 only, for units sold from March 2024- May 2025. Small metal pieces can detach from the garlic press posing a laceration or ingestion risk.
remedy: Small metal pieces can detach from the garlic press posing a laceration or ingestion risk. Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return to any IKEA store for a full refund. Affected recalled product can be identified by a marking of the IKEA logo on the upper handle of the product. If you are unable to return to a store, please contact us for instructions on how to dispose of confirmed recalled product to receive a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required to receive a full refund.

title: IKEA recalls certain VARMFRONT Power Banks due to fire hazard
hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of certain VARMFRONT power banks. Due to a manufacturing issue the power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
remedy: The recall includes date stamps for both versions of the VARMFRONT power banks: 10400 mAh (model number E2038) with date stamp (YYWW) 2313, 2316, 2318 or 2319, or 5200 mAh (model number E2037) with date stamp (YYWW) 2318, 2319 or 2322. The date stamp is located on the backside of the product, in the bottom right-hand corner in YYWW format. VARMFRONT power banks with other date stamps are not affected by this recall.

title: IKEA recalls ÅSKSTORM USB charger due to burn and electric shock hazard
hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the ÅSKSTORM 40W USB Charger. The recalled USB charger’s cable can become damaged or break over time, posing burn and electric shock hazards.
remedy: The recalled USB charger was sold in the US stores and online between April 2020 through December 2023 for about $30. Model number ICPSW5-40-1 is printed on the label on the back side of the grey USB-charger. Please immediately stop use and return it to any IKEA store for a full refund or if you are unable to return to a store, please contact us for instructions on how to dispose of the charger to receive a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required.

title: IKEA recalls BLÅVINGAD fishing game due to choking hazard.
hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the BLÅVINGAD fishing game. A small metal rivet on the wooden play piece can come loose, posing a choking hazard.
remedy: The recalled games have been sold in US stores and online between October 2022 and March 2023 for about $14.99.
